images.caption: Every red box is a ship: 268 vessels detected in one radar pass over the Singapore Strait anchorage — one of the busiest shipping lanes on Earth. Radar sees through cloud and darkness, which is why it is the workhorse for finding vessels that switch their transponders off.
images.source: Sentinel-1 SAR via Microsoft Planetary Computer (anonymous)

images.caption: The five strongest radar returns, zoomed in — estimated lengths from the detection footprint. Cross-matching these against live AIS transponder feeds is what separates honest traffic from dark vessels.
images.source: Sentinel-1 SAR via Microsoft Planetary Computer (anonymous)
